responsibility: Declares the user-visible command-line options for the MicroBlaze target and maps them onto GCC target flags and variables. It defines CPU selection, endian choice, floating-point and arithmetic hardware feature switches, GP/small-data behavior, prefetch and PIC-data modes, legacy boot/runtime mode options, and associated diagnostics or driver-only handling, forming the option table from which GCC generates target option parsing code.
same_name_distinction: This is the target option-definition file that lists MicroBlaze-specific switches such as -mcpu=, endian selection, soft/hard float, GP optimization, prefetch, and mode options, from which GCC generates option parsing/flag wiring. Unlike microblaze.cc it does not implement backend behavior, unlike microblaze.h it does not define target ABI/spec macros, and unlike microblaze.md it does not encode RTL instruction patterns or scheduling.
